objective: At the owner's request ('Yes continue', approving the recommendation of SELECTION-NOTE-20261101-001 and KNOT-COMPOSE-20261101-001): test whether the knot's spaces carry native paths and native separation, the next rungs after composed topology. status: Complete 2026-11-01: routes between the parts of a knot's space are fixed by the space but are not native paths. Routes carry their length mod 2 or nothing, separate when both are cut, and count 5 per unit; KNOT-COMPOSE's 'compose only through hubs' withdrawn and recorded (the note needs an erratum); next: Full pivot to selection versus composition (2/3)
